item: 129 odd or conflicting locale values fixed in seven languages
summary: Values only, never keys; each change agreed by two independent reads per language: pt pista gender and Embaralhada; zh Map 地图; ja Interval 間隔; ru Advanced Дополнительно; bn Source উৎস and at-rest সংরক্ষিত অবস্থায়; de Überbelichtet and the lane term Strang; ar corpus مجموعة (also in simple mode).
